situations.title: 저혈압 초기 활력 인지
situations.tagline: I feel so weak and cold — is my blood pressure okay?
situations.brief: 혈압·맥박·의식·말초관류를 확인해 저혈압 초기 상태를 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me take your blood pressure and check your pulse.
Your hands feel cool — I'm checking your circulation.
How long have you been feeling weak like this?

situations.title: 기립성 저혈압 문진
situations.tagline: Every time I stand up, the room spins and I nearly fall.
situations.brief: 기립 시 어지럼·수분 섭취를 문진해 기립성 저혈압을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you feel dizzy only when you stand up?
How much have you had to drink today?
I'll check your blood pressure lying down and standing.
goals: 기립 시 증상과 수분 상태를 청취한다

situations.title: 대구경 정맥로·수액 설명
situations.tagline: Why do I need such a big needle and all this fluid?
situations.brief: 대구경 정맥로 확보와 수액 볼루스의 이유를 환자에게 설명하며 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm placing a larger IV so we can give fluids quickly.
This fluid will help bring your blood pressure up.
You'll feel a quick pinch, then a cool sensation in your arm.

situations.title: 탈수 관련 저혈압 교육
situations.tagline: I've been throwing up for two days and can't keep water down.
situations.brief: 구토·설사·섭취 부족과 저혈압의 관계를 교육하고 수분 회복을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Losing that much fluid can lower your blood pressure.
We'll give fluids through your vein to catch you up.
Once you feel better, we'll try small sips slowly.

situations.title: 실신 후 내원 사정
situations.tagline: I just dropped at the store — I don't even remember hitting the floor.
situations.brief: 실신 전조·목격 정황·손상 여부를 사정해 원인을 좁히세요.
keyPhrases: Do you remember feeling anything before you fainted?
Did anyone see what happened?
Did you hit your head or hurt yourself when you fell?

situations.title: 저혈량성 쇼크 출혈원 사정
situations.tagline: I've had black, tarry stools and now I feel like I'm going to pass out.
situations.brief: 흑색변·외상·부인과 출혈 등을 감별해 저혈량성 쇼크의 출혈원을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you noticed any black or bloody stools?
Are you taking any blood thinners?
We're getting fluids and blood ready for you.

situations.title: 패혈증성 쇼크 조기 인지
situations.tagline: I've had a fever and chills, and now I just feel completely out of it.
situations.brief: 발열·빈맥·의식변화·젖산 등 패혈증성 쇼크의 조기 소견을 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: You feel warm and your heart is racing — I'm concerned about infection.
Where do you think the infection might be coming from?
We're drawing cultures and lactate and starting fluids fast.

situations.title: 심인성 쇼크 감별
situations.tagline: My chest has been heavy and now I can't catch my breath lying down.
situations.brief: 흉통·폐부종·경정맥 확장을 확인해 심인성 쇼크를 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Does the chest heaviness spread to your arm or jaw?
Is it harder to breathe when you lie flat?
We're getting an ECG and listening to your lungs now.
goals: 심장 원인에 맞춘 초기 사정을 수행한다

situations.title: 아나필락시스 분포성 쇼크
situations.tagline: I ate shellfish and now my throat feels tight and I'm covered in hives.
situations.brief: 노출력·발진을 확인하고 아나필락시스에 에피네프린 투여를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm giving you epinephrine in your thigh right now.
What did you eat or take before this started?
Does your throat or tongue feel tight?

situations.title: 수액 반응성 평가
situations.tagline: You gave me all that fluid — am I doing any better?
situations.brief: 볼루스 후 혈압·소변량 변화를 재사정해 수액 반응성을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: After the fluid, your pressure came up a little.
We're watching your urine output as a good sign.
If you don't improve, we'll add another treatment.
goals: 수액 반응성에 따라 다음 조치를 판단한다

situations.title: 승압제 시작 전 설명
situations.tagline: What's this new medicine going into my neck line for?
situations.brief: 노르에피네프린 등 승압제 시작과 중심정맥로의 이유를 환자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: This medicine helps raise and hold your blood pressure.
We use the neck line so it works quickly and safely.
We'll watch you very closely while it's running.

situations.title: 항응고제 복용 저혈압
situations.tagline: I'm on a blood thinner, and now I feel faint — could I be bleeding inside?
situations.brief: 항응고제 복용력과 출혈 위험을 확인해 저혈압 원인을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Which blood thinner do you take, and when was your last dose?
Any recent falls, bruising, or dark stools?
We're checking your blood count and clotting right away.

situations.title: 언어장벽 쇼크 핵심 확인
situations.tagline: Sangre... aquí... duele mucho.
situations.brief: 언어장벽 저혈압 환자에게 예/아니오로 통증·출혈·알레르기를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Bleeding? Point to where. Yes or no?
Pain here? Yes or no?
Any allergy to medicine? Interpreter is coming.

situations.title: 노인 다약제 저혈압
situations.tagline: I take a lot of pills — my heart and water pills, and now I'm so dizzy.
situations.brief: 강압제·이뇨제 등 다약제 과용 여부를 확인해 저혈압 원인을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Can we go through all the medicines you took today?
Did you take an extra dose of any blood pressure pill?
Water pills and heart pills together can drop your pressure.

situations.title: 원인 미상 저혈압 계통 접근
situations.tagline: I just don't feel right, and they say my pressure is low — but why?
situations.brief: 병력과 검사 우선순위를 정해 원인 미상 저혈압에 계통적으로 접근하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's start from the beginning — when did you last feel well?
Any fever, bleeding, chest pain, or new medications?
We're running labs and an ECG to find the cause.

situations.title: 패혈증성 쇼크 급속 악화 번들
situations.tagline: She's dropping fast — pressure won't come up despite the fluids.
situations.brief: 급속 악화 패혈증성 쇼크에서 승압·항생제·젖산 번들을 신속히 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Fluids aren't holding — start norepinephrine now.
Get broad-spectrum antibiotics in within the hour.
Recheck the lactate and keep the MAP above 65.

situations.title: 폐색전 폐쇄성 쇼크
situations.tagline: He suddenly can't breathe, his leg is swollen, and his pressure crashed.
situations.brief: 우심부전 소견을 확인하고 폐색전에 의한 폐쇄성 쇼크와 혈전용해를 대비하세요.
keyPhrases: The swollen leg and crash suggest a massive PE.
Get a bedside echo to look at the right heart.
Prepare thrombolytics and notify the team.
goals: 폐색전 폐쇄성 쇼크를 임상 소견으로 인지한다

situations.title: 심장압전 폐쇄성 쇼크
situations.tagline: Her pressure's low, neck veins are bulging, and heart sounds are muffled.
situations.brief: 저혈압·경정맥 확장·심음 감소를 통합해 심장압전을 인지하고 심낭천자를 대비하세요.
keyPhrases: Low pressure, big neck veins, muffled tones — think tamponade.
Get the ultrasound and call for a pericardiocentesis kit.
Give a fluid bolus while we prepare the drain.

situations.title: 소화관 대량출혈 쇼크
situations.tagline: He's vomiting bright red blood and his pressure keeps falling.
situations.brief: 소화관 대량출혈 쇼크에서 대량수혈 프로토콜을 개시하고 팀을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Activate the massive transfusion protocol now.
Two large-bore IVs and get O-negative blood up here.
Call GI for emergent endoscopy.

situations.title: 신경성 쇼크 척수손상
situations.tagline: He fell off the roof — his pressure's low but his heart rate's slow too.
situations.brief: 저혈압에 서맥이 동반된 신경성 쇼크를 인지하고 척추 고정을 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: Low pressure with a slow heart rate points to neurogenic shock.
Keep full spinal precautions — don't move his neck.
Give fluids and consider a pressor and atropine.

situations.title: 다장기 악화 SBAR·ICU 이송
situations.tagline: She's on pressors and still slipping — I think she needs the ICU now.
situations.brief: 승압제 유지 중 재사정 결과를 SBAR로 보고하고 ICU 이송을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Situation: septic shock on norepinephrine, still hypotensive.
Her urine output dropped and lactate is climbing.
I recommend ICU admission and central monitoring now.

situations.title: 부신위기 저혈압
situations.tagline: I take steroids every day but ran out — now I'm weak and my pressure's low.
situations.brief: 스테로이드 중단력을 확인하고 부신위기에 hydrocortisone 투여를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you last take your steroid, and why did you stop?
Missing your steroids can cause a dangerous crisis.
We're giving hydrocortisone and fluids right away.
